why: A PDF carries text that no review of the site's HTML will ever see. The resume published here originally contained a phone number, because it was copied straight from the version used for job applications, and nothing in the build was in a position to notice. Every PDF that reaches the output must therefore be listed below with the hash of the exact bytes that were read and approved. An unlisted PDF, or a listed one whose bytes changed, fails the build.
howToUpdate: Open the new file, read it, confirm it carries no phone number, street address, or anything else that should not be public, then run: shasum -a 256 public/media/<file> and paste the hash here with today's date. Updating the hash without reading the document defeats the point of the check.

media/stephen-zhang-resume.pdf.note: Rebuilt from the LaTeX source with the phone line removed. Header reads email and city only. One page, content otherwise identical to the application version. Regenerated 2026-09-16 with tectonic after the Alpha AI bullet changed to multi-billion-parameter. Extracted text and a raw byte scan both show no phone number and no filesystem path; XMP carries title, author, and subject only.

media/scores/concert-symphony-iii.pdf.checkedFor: phone number, street address, email address, filesystem paths, embedded metadata
media/scores/concert-symphony-iii.pdf.note: Full orchestral score, 48 pages, exported from MuseScore. Every word of extracted text is either a tempo or playing indication, an instrument name, the work title, or the composer credit. XMP carries the title and the MuseScore version and nothing else.
